description:
Hits DataForSEO's LLM Mentions corpus to return the observed AI prompts where a target shows up: the LLM answer, its cited sources (with position + publication date), where the target sits among them, and the AI search volume trend. Covers Google AI Overviews (worldwide) + ChatGPT (US/EN). Unlike live engine audits it's an already-crawled corpus: historical depth and competitor coverage.

Billing: 75¢ at most per call — 5¢ per prompt found, at least 30¢ (1–6 prompts 30¢, 15+ prompts 75¢). Not billed when nothing is found or the lookup fails.

Inputs:
  site_id — the site to attach the saved report to (required — MCP doesn't auto-pin a site).
  target_type — "domain" (returns every prompt citing this domain) or "keyword" (returns the AI answer + every cited domain for this prompt/topic).
  target — the domain (e.g. "linear.app") or keyword (e.g. "best pm tool for startups").
  platform — "google" (default, AI Overviews worldwide) or "chat_gpt" (US/EN only).
  limit — prompts to pull from the corpus (default 50, max 100); all of them count toward prompt_count and unique_domains_cited.

Output: { report_id, url, title, target, platform, checked_domain, prompt_count, prompts_citing_checked_domain, unique_domains_cited, prompts_returned, charged_cents, prompts: [{question, answer_preview, target_position, target_in_answer, sources: [{domain, url, position, publication_date?}], more_sources?, ai_search_volume, trend: {month, volume, change_3m_pct, change_12m_pct} | null}] } — prompts holds the 25 with the most AI search volume, each with the first 10 cited sources plus checked_domain's own entry wherever it sits. checked_domain is the target for a domain pull and the site's own domain for a keyword pull; target_position is its 1-based position among the answer's sources (null: not cited) and target_in_answer whether the answer names it. url opens the saved kind="llm_mentions" site_report (top 20 by volume) in the dashboard.

Example: { site_id: "…", target_type: "domain", target: "asana.com" }

limit.description: Prompts to pull (default 50); the 25 with the most AI search volume are returned.

platform.description: AI platform to pull from. Default "google".

site_id.description: Site to attach the saved report to (site_id from list_sites).

target.description: The domain (e.g. "linear.app") or keyword (e.g. "best pm tool for startups").

target_type.description: Whether `target` is a domain or a keyword.

name: explore_llm_mentions
title: Pull historical AI citation corpus for a domain or keyword
